ideo.name: Path of Scavengers
ideo.description: "We were content with our simple lives of scavenging, with little need for the extravagant luxuries of our ancestors. Our fight for survival was showing us that the true measure and power of a man lies in profit. Perhaps ancient technology is junk, or perhaps it is the key to our survival."

li.name: Interment of Scrap
li.ritualExpectedDesc: Once a {IDEO} member dies, other {MEMBERS} witness their friend return to space.

li.name: funeral (no corpse)
li.ritualExpectedDesc: Once a {IDEO} member dies and the body is lost, other {MEMBERS} gather around an empty grave for {RITUAL_labelDef}.

li.name: Profitting Jubilee
li.ritualExplanation: We'll tear apart this technology and make good use of it

li.name: Scrounging Revel
li.descOverride: A celebratory gathering for your colonists to have fun and drink. A leader will give an encouraging speech, then everyone will socialize and drink drinks prepared for the party.
li.ritualExpectedDesc: Every year on {DATE}, {MEMBERS} drink and celebrate {RITUAL_labelDef}.

li.name: conversion ritual
li.ritualExplanation: In case of success, their certainty will be reduced or they will convert immediately. If it backfires, their certainty in own beliefs will increase.

li.name: wedding ceremony
li.descOverride: A wedding ceremony where colonists gather near the marriage spot to celebrate a magical union under the canopy of love.

li.name: advance to industrial
li.descOverride: Upon completing all medieval research projects, advance to industrial tech level. This will allow you to pick a Cornerstone - a powerful bonus that applies only to your civilization.

li.name: advance to medieval
li.descOverride: Upon completing all neolithic research projects, advance to medieval tech level. This will allow you to pick a Cornerstone - a powerful bonus that applies only to your civilization.

li.name: advance to neolithic
li.descOverride: Upon completing all pre-neolithic research projects, advance to neolithic tech level. This will allow you to pick a Cornerstone - a powerful bonus that applies only to your civilization.

li.name: advance to spacer
li.descOverride: Upon completing all industrial research projects, advance to spacer tech level. This will allow you to pick a Cornerstone - a powerful bonus that applies only to your civilization.

li.name: advance to ultratech
li.descOverride: Upon completing all spacer research projects, advance to ultratech tech level. This will allow you to pick a Cornerstone - a powerful bonus that applies only to your civilization.

li.name: tribal gathering
li.descOverride: Gather the participants to try and brainstorm a way through the research projects. Grants small amounts of research progress to random, available research projects for each participant.
